the association between CCA-IM and PWV is lost in subjects with type 2 diabetes, and that the association between IMT and Alx is lost in subjects without diabetes.

AASI, PWV and AI are different parameters that are not always interchangeable and that they do not behave equally in subjects with or without type 2 DM.
